messages:
Anya Patel: Quick preflight — gateway + LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter compatibility check before the joint announcement. Who owns final marketplace listing copy, and can we confirm SI enablement docs?
Mike Chen: I can own the adapter release notes and sample config. working on adapter v1.2, API surface matches gateway but need a small sample from LangChain for test harness. @Daniel can you grab that?
Daniel Rivera: Pinging their eng contact. also need to confirm which LlamaIndex index types we should validate (list, tree, vector). I think vector + list is minimum.
Sara Lee: Timeline question — marketing wants to announce Wed next week. We need: final one-pager, joint blog draft, marketplace listing + screenshots, and SI enablement checklist by EOD Mon. doable? :calendar:
Tom Anders: Heads up — NeuronX (hardware partner) wants to co-sponsor the announcement. They asked for throughput numbers on our Dedicated pools for their instance types. Mike — can you add perf pins to the release notes?
Mike Chen: Yep — I'll add a short perf table and a command to reproduce locally. example:
```bash
# run gateway adapter smoke test
python tools/adapter_smoke.py --model gpt-small --batch 8 --seq 512 --backend dedicated
```
I'll include a small CSV with tokens/sec per instance.
Daniel Rivera: For the LangChain test harness we should provide a connector snippet. suggested minimal example: 
```python
from redwood_gateway import RedwoodAdapter
from langchain import LLMChain
adapter = RedwoodAdapter(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
chain = LLMChain(llm=adapter)
print(chain.run("Summarize: Redwood features"))
```
Anya Patel: Perfect. Also add a note about automatic fallback to smaller quantized variants (important for SIs). short blurb for marketplace: "Seamless LLM routing with runtime fallbacks and predictable throughput."
partner-ci-bot: adapter-tests: 12/12 passed on branch release/v1.2 — integration smoke OK. (logs: https://ci.internal/ci/9876)
Sara Lee: Marketing will draft the blog and share by EOD Tue for review. Can someone volunteer to sign off on technical accuracy on Wed morning?
Mike Chen: I can review Wed AM. will validate perf numbers + config snippets.
Tom Anders: I'll coordinate the NeuronX co-sponsor assets (logo + quote) and sync with legal.
Anya Patel: Great — owners noted: marketplace & release notes = Mike, langchain connector sample = Daniel, marketing assets = Sara, hardware assets = Tom. I'll collate and send final checklist to the channel Monday. :thumbsup:
